name: @openclinxr/png-measure
purpose: General PNG measurement any consumer may use: the shared 8-bit PNG decoder and the region-aware luminance reader evidence contracts grade captures with.

exportSummaries.DecodedPng: Decoded PNG pixels: dimensions, luminance, per-channel bytes, and the greyscale flag.
exportSummaries.RegionFractions: Fractional rectangle selecting the measured region; defaults to the whole image.
exportSummaries.RegionLuminance: Luminance summary over a region: samples, mean, sd, non-black share, median, p90.
exportSummaries.decodePng: Decode an 8-bit non-interlaced PNG into per-pixel luminance and channels; null when undecodable.
exportSummaries.regionLuminance: Summarise luminance over a rectangular region of an 8-bit PNG; null when undecodable.
